purpose: Maximize long-run expected GP growth by ranking capital on probability-weighted GP velocity, scalable capacity, execution quality and opportunity cost rather than headline ROI.
ranking_rule: ROI is secondary to expected GP/hour and expected profit at realistic capacity. A smaller percentage edge can outrank a larger one if it scales better, fills more reliably, consumes less player time or recycles capital faster.

capital_velocity.rule: Compare every new trade and existing speculative position with what the same GP could plausibly earn elsewhere over the same time window.

capacity_and_slippage.rule: Never assume a one-unit spread scales to a full GE limit. Size from observed turnover, buy limit, liquidity and conservative market participation.

ge_slot_optimizer.rule: Treat GE slots as scarce capital infrastructure. Prefer high slot-efficiency opportunities and do not occupy slots with weak passive orders when a materially higher-GP/hour trade exists.

player_time.rule: Report raw conversion profit and player-time-adjusted profit separately. Manual labor can make a large percentage margin inferior to a passive trade.

capital_aging.rule: Expected-payoff windows are part of the original thesis. Positions that overstay without improved evidence receive an opportunity-cost penalty; hold-for-use gear is exempt.

shadow_learning.rule: Record qualified signals even when not traded, then grade their subsequent behavior. Do not overfit small samples; confirmed user executions remain stronger evidence.

market_regime.rule: Use liquid-universe breadth to alter selectivity: risk-off increases cash value and demands stronger rebound evidence; risk-on increases the value of momentum only when execution remains healthy.

evergreen_staple_reversion.goal: Find liquid, durably consumed items temporarily depressed versus their own recent range.
evergreen_staple_reversion.structural_bear_check: Reject mean reversion when permanent supply, substitutes, balance changes, bot/activity changes or demand destruction make the old range obsolete.

risk_budget.thin_item_sizing_policy: Apply a substantial capacity penalty; nominal ROI never overrides exit difficulty.
risk_budget.unknown_cash_policy: Do not infer cash. Build a ranked capacity frontier until liquid GP is explicitly known.
risk_budget.hold_for_use_policy: Separate hold-for-use gear from deployable trading capital.
risk_budget.averaging_down_policy: Never add merely because price is below basis.

exclusions: update-day noise with no item-specific edge
